summary.text: Jennifer Poirier is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 70 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She has served in the Maine House since 2020 and was ranking member of the Judiciary Committee in 2023-2024.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Poirier lives in Skowhegan, Maine.
Her career experience includes working as a community living coordinator with Living Innovations, a customer service agent with T-Mobile, and a store manager with 3D Games.
Ballotpedia also lists service on the board of directors of MSAD 54 and an affiliation with the local Head Start program.
Poirier first won a seat in the Maine House in 2020, when she defeated incumbent Betty Austin in District 107, and she won District 70 in 2022 and 2024.
She served on the Judiciary Committee in 2021-2022 and as its ranking member in 2023-2024.
